prompt: A vertical 9:16 night photograph split into a grid of six panes, two across and three down, by thin straight black metal glazing bars, like an old window frame between camera and street. Each pane holds a head-and-shoulders portrait of the same young man with the same face: early twenties, short dark hair, untucked white going-out shirt, flushed and sweaty, a lanyard of car keys in one hand. In each pane he wears a different look: grinning, eyes closed mid-sway, worried, smug, wincing, staring at the keys. Slightly low angle, 85mm lens at f/1.8, faces crisp, warm amber pub light on one cheek, the city behind dissolving into big soft bokeh of amber, red, pink and cyan above deep inky blacks, a glowing TAXI roof sign blurred in the background. Thanks.
